preconditions.description: The `to_currency` argument must be either 'USD' or 'EUR'.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, float) for x in values_list)
preconditions.description: All elements in `values_list` must be floats.
All values in `values_list` must be non-negative.

postconditions.description: The output list must have the same length as the input `values_list`.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, str) for x in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each element in the output list must be a string.

postconditions.expression: all(',' in x for x in return_value) and all('.00' in x for x in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each output string must contain a comma (for thousands separator) and exactly two decimal places (rounded).

postconditions.expression: all(x.endswith('€') if to_currency == 'EUR' else x.startswith('$') for x in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each output string must end with '€' if `to_currency` is 'EUR', or start with '$' if `to_currency` is 'USD'.

postconditions.expression: all((lambda x: (x.replace('$', '').replace('€', '')).replace(',', '')).split('.')[1] == '00' for x in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each output string must represent a value rounded to exactly two decimal places.

postconditions.expression: all((lambda x: float((x.replace('$', '').replace('€', '').replace(',', '')).split('.')[0])) == round(values_list[i] * (1 / 1.1363636), 2) if to_currency == 'EUR' else round(values_list[i] * 1.1363636, 2) for i, x in enumerate(return_value))
postconditions.description: For each value in `values_list`, the converted amount in the output string must equal the input value multiplied by the exchange rate (1.1363636 for USD, 1/1.1363636 for EUR), rounded to two decimal places.
